standards.name: LINCS iPSC Metadata Specification (2017)
standards.abstract: Metadata specification for induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines used by the LINCS consortium. The document lists canonical and batch-specific metadata fields describing cell identity, provenance (origin/precursor), culture and passaging conditions, genetic and molecular features, provider and batch identifiers, and quality verification. The data modality is structured tabular metadata (field names, descriptions, importance levels) for cell-line-level and batch-level records.

classification.rationale: The source is a tabular metadata specification listing field names, descriptions and importance levels for iPSC records; it is best represented as a metadata table.
